name: entity-required-states
goal: The Required states of an entity are exactly the applicable required states its proof and capture selector judge, from the one authoritative scenarioFor and the registry that holds the entity.

evidence: Failing: the Contract of an entity lists every required state of each scenario that names it. On this repository's own history at 6f1e9ff the Pages page lists 32 states while its capture selector offers only pages. Expected: the required states are those the proof judges, from the host's scenarioFor read with the units of the registry that holds the entity (the parent's for a removed entity), unnarrowed where it cannot narrow. Reproduction: test/utils/entity-contract.test.ts, entity-shown.test.ts, test/components/entity-overview.test.ts over a registry whose states name their page.

bunx vitest run test/utils/entity-contract.test.ts test/utils/entity-shown.test.ts test/components/entity-overview.test.ts -> 6 failed, 20 passed (states-RED.log): expected ['a','a-empty'], received ['a','a-empty','b','c']; expected 'default, empty', received 'default, empty, returns'; Overview lacked 'Required states default, empty'. The unknown-scope case passed, as it must before and after. Test hashes in states-tests.sha256.

requiredStates(unit, scenarios, units) narrows each covering scenario with data's scenarioFor before it lists required states; entityShown passes the scenarios and units of the same held registry. Two source files, no second applicability rule, no proof code touched.
Same four test files, hashes unchanged: 26 passed (states-GREEN.log). Whole reports unit suite 473 passed in 125 files; svelte-check 0 errors; eslint and prettier clean on the changed files.

Reports: vitest 473 passed in 125 files, svelte-check 0 errors, eslint, prettier and harness audit clean; harness explain check: every change is explained (3 reasons). Isolated latest build, own ports: complete browser suite 139 passed, preview 24 passed. Actual own-repository history at 6f1e9ff, read only: the review build on 5693 lists 32 required states for the Pages page while its selector offers pages; my build lists pages, equal to the selector, on Overview and Details at desktop, tablet and mobile; Function page 3 of 3, Explorer pages screen 2 of 2, shared Entity frame 26 of 26; no source in default views. Captures inspected, in entities-evidence/pass5/real. Not run by me: root bun run check, the shared index and source-bound verification.
